question: Does F124-H Arm B beat a fixed public-graph traversal after honest operation accounting, and are original 7-9-hop reserved cohorts actually executable in an independently witnessed first use?

fixed_controls.C12: Nonlearned public directed role-sequence graph traversal with >=12/16 Hamming bit matches between carried dst_bits and next src_bits.
fixed_controls.C14: Same fixed public traversal with >=14/16 matches; fixed before this new audit. Exploratory control, not retroactively eligible model selector.
fixed_controls.C16: Exact 16/16 public raw-bit relation composition; separate computational reference ceiling, never included as eligible heuristic for F124-H original +0.05 scientific threshold. This correct algorithm is allowed public information, must be counted, and cannot be hidden from conclusions.
fixed_controls.admission: All use exactly the same public {start,target,roles,edges}; no ground-truth label or oracle branch fed to controls; no threshold adaptation from result; parity of positive/negative topology and token multiset verified.
fixed_controls.counting: Count actual edge scans and actual 16-bit comparison evaluations for C12/C14/C16 per paired input. Record edge scans, model raw-bit multiply-adds, exp and sigmoid operations, peak memory, parameter counts separately. No unit conversion, padding, or assumption that heterogeneous operations are equivalent.
fixed_controls.resource_decision: Only assert a provable dominance under separately itemized operations; if units differ, report incomparable and mark resource-matched superiority unqualified. C16 symbolic correctness does not retroactively invalidate original frozen eligibility rules but exposes the task's public algorithmic upper bound.
fixed_controls.source: Use ONLY 2 authenticated F123 TRAIN vectors per Wingless/Yggdrasil, 24 frozen seeds/vector and 48 positive-negative TRAIN pairs per lane; never generate reserved CONFIRM.

protected_confirmation_preflight.observed_source_capability: f124h_source.build accepts phase==TRAIN, with TRAIN only seed ranges and hops 4 or 5. validate accepts len(roles) 4 or 5. The existing source cannot honestly perform 7-9-hop CONFIRM.
recovery_requirements: Independently implement and freeze complete source-born 7-9-hop CONFIRM generator with distinct sealed salt and no TRAIN data dependence.
Qualify source-shape and scorer contracts on disjoint TRAIN-like fixture seeds only; never probe real reserved cases as tests.
Freeze exact model weights (the frozen per-lane Arm B SHA-256s), public comparator code, source generator blobs, seed intervals and original predictions before any protected generation.
Obtain independent authentic first-use authorization/custody; one time irreversible operation, source-birth, bounded contamination prevention and sealed signed evidence.
Execute one-time reserved confirmation ONLY after all conditions; immutable positive and negative records; no recalibration, training, retry, or posthoc candidate choice.
protected_confirmation_preflight.non_authenticity: Source validation tests against TRAIN are not equivalent to first-use authorization, independent signatures or source-born prospective evidence.
